name: Collage / zine
when: A bold product ad for a young, trend-led audience (sneakers, streetwear, beauty, drinks, music, events) that should feel hand-made and loud.
look: Cut-outs with white sticker borders on flat poster colours, torn paper, halftone and duotone photos, sunbursts and big stamped type
pace: Fast: a new scene every second or less, rapid card montages, a held end card
